##Three-Space Low Pincer

This pincer is even more leisurely than the two-space pincer.  It's the most distant move that is still a pincer. It may also qualify as an extension from an existing position in the upper left corner.

[Explanation by Go Inside on Youtube (SDK/Dan)](https://youtu.be/FzV95UuM7aA?si=EoIXY3F3CFP2yTA-&t=488)
